description:
Where the eye is predicted to land on a thumbnail: the picture with a heatmap over it (PNG,
    base64), a 16 by 9 grid, the peak, the share in each third, the concentration and the share in
    YouTube's length corner. UNISAL (AUC 0.895 on MIT1003): faces draw it strongly, printed words
    less than people read them; a prediction, not a click-through rate. Free. Same as POST
    /v1/thumbnails/attention.

thumbnail.description: a JPEG, PNG or WebP in base64 or an i.ytimg.com URL
thumbnail.title: Thumbnail

video_url.description: or a YouTube video: its own thumbnail is read
